sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach have won seven of their last ten games and currently sit top of the table with 22 points, while Alsager Town arrive in poor form with just one win from ten games and occupy the bottom two positions.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough away trip to Dawley Town, hoping to keep pace with Sandbach despite recent inconsistency (one draw in their last two). Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth visit Eccleshall in what could be a competitive mid-table clash, while in-form Wolverhampton Casuals (winners of their last outing) host Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir in a match between clubs separated by just one point in the table. Elsewhere, Barnton entertain Shawbury United—both seeking to climb away from mid-table, though Shawbury's recent form is dire with just one win in their last six. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town in a struggle between lower-mid-table sides, while Crewe host Allscott Heath in a fixture between teams battling to avoid the bottom reaches. Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town, the division's lowest-ranked side who have yet to record a win this season. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town in a match between two of the division's struggling outfits.
